audit.why: The content-layer early/mid/late already state the correct shape: Xerath dominates via out-range poke from level 1 through first item, Lulu inverts it at two items by closing distance on his zero-mobility kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[].side only has Xerath on rows 0-1; rows 2-5 are flat 'Skill', contradicting both the packet levelChart and the content win[]/whys[], which give Xerath all six early/mid/item stages and Lulu only the 2+ items stage.
audit.why: Xerath's kit out-ranges Lulu's entirely (Arcanopulse 750, Eye of Destruction 1000, Rite of the Arcane 5000) and he has zero escape/mobility, so the lane stays his until Lulu's two-item CC and mobility let her close distance and shut his artillery off with Whimsy.
audit.corrected: phases[2].side, phases[3].side, phases[4].side, phases[5].side set to Xerath (matching win[]); phases[6].side set to Lulu (matching win[]); ratings and why rewritten on every changed row plus rows 0-1 whose why was still the generic Lulu-poke template despite the side already being correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: Xerath's ultimate is fabricated in three places as 'Rite of the Ancients / Arcane Barrage' (spikes[1].text) and 'Arcane Barrage' (whys[4], mid) — the real name per champ-data/_kits/xerath.json is 'Rite of the Arcane'.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon (champ-data/_kits/xerath.json) lists the R slot as 'Rite of the Arcane' with no secondary name; 'Arcane Barrage' does not exist in the kit data, matching the pattern the calibration notes warn about (fabricated ability names).
audit.corrected: Replaced all three occurrences with 'Rite of the Arcane (R)' / 'Rite of the Arcane'. Also fixed the lint-flagged 'Help Pix' pronoun-style truncation in early[] to the real name 'Help, Pix!'.

edits.before: Rite of the Ancients / Arcane Barrage (R) gives him three long-range artillery shots that can chunk or pick your ADC from screens away. Your Wild Growth (R) heal-and-knockup is the answer, but he out-ranges you, so save it to save your carry after a shot lands, not to engage into him.
edits.after: Rite of the Arcane (R) gives him three long-range artillery shots that can chunk or pick your ADC from screens away. Your Wild Growth (R) heal-and-knockup is the answer, but he out-ranges you, so save it to save your carry after a shot lands, not to engage into him.

edits.before: His level-6 Arcane Barrage threatens long-range picks on your ADC.
edits.after: His level-6 Rite of the Arcane threatens long-range picks on your ADC.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 the poke war stays lost: his Q/W/E zone the wave and his level-6 Arcane Barrage threatens picks from long range, so play safe, ward the sides against roams, and only step up when you can punish a whiffed stun.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 the poke war stays lost: his Q/W/E zone the wave and his level-6 Rite of the Arcane threatens picks from long range, so play safe, ward the sides against roams, and only step up when you can punish a whiffed stun.

edits.before: Xerath's level-1 charged Arcanopulse out-ranges your entire kit; his Q and Eye of Destruction poke you for far more than Glitterlance answers, so hug minions, hold Help Pix (E) for his Q, and just keep your ADC healthy.
edits.after: Xerath's level-1 charged Arcanopulse out-ranges your entire kit; his Q and Eye of Destruction poke you for far more than Glitterlance answers, so hug minions, hold Help, Pix! (E) for his Q, and just keep your ADC healthy.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and the artillery never converts. The duo's tempo bends around it. - Keep W Whimsy banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Xerath Shocking Orb (E): matchup-defining — his only CC, 13s at rank 1 — dodge it and the poke never converts to a kill. - Keep W Whimsy banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Glitterlance the contacts — the Pix angles double your poke and the chip is constant.
edits.after: His charged Arcanopulse out-ranges your entire kit from level 1 — he pokes, you can't answer.

edits.before: E-mark trades begin: Pix on the carry makes every auto a volley.
edits.after: His Q plus Eye of Destruction slow zone you off the wave at level 2.

edits.before: Polymorph online — their engage now has a 1.5-second hole where a champion used to be.
edits.after: His full Q/W/E poke rotation controls the lane at a range you can't contest yet.

edits.before: Chip and mark the margins; hold W for the dive their kit is saving up for.
edits.after: He pokes safely through 4-5 while Whimsy and Help, Pix! only heal and shield you.

edits.before: Wild Growth online — burst math on your carry dies; the knockup punishes the divers who try.
edits.after: Rite of the Arcane threatens long-range picks on any ADC his poke has feathered.

edits.before: First item: shields compound and the polymorph windows decide every 2v2.
edits.after: First item: his artillery poke turns lethal while you stay purely reactive.

edits.before: Late Lulu deletes dives: poly the assassin, grow the carry, and watch their plan become a squirrel.
edits.after: Two items flip it: you reach his zero-mobility kit with CC, Wild Growth peels, Whimsy shuts him off.
